result.topic_en: Computation of the gravitational potential of a thin spherical shell (and hence a solid sphere) at an external or internal point, by integrating mass elements in spherical coordinates and changing variables to the distance f.

methods.what: Mass element of a spherical shell in spherical coordinates
Potential element as mass element divided by distance
Integration over the azimuthal angle gives factor 2π
Law of cosines for distance and its differential, used to change variable from θ to f
Differential relation substituting f df for sinθ dθ
Potential of shell after integration in f between limits
Limits of f for external and internal points
Resulting shell potential: 4πu²du/r outside, 4πu du inside
